description: Deterministic protocol-peer scenarios for the Agent Core execution-modes harness. Scenario selection is harness-only and authenticated; the peers are test artifacts and must never be packaged into a production image.
source: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-22-agent-core-execution-modes-design.md section 8.2 plus e2e/agent-core/fixtures recordings from Task 1

notes: A peer refuses to start unless ARIA_PEER_CONTROL_TOKEN (>= 16 characters) is present in its environment.
The scenario is chosen at launch time; there is no per-request scenario selection route.
The mock OpenCode control routes require the same token as an x-peer-control-token header.
A non-numeric or out-of-range --port fails closed with the usage exit code (peer.invalid_port), never with a NaN listen throw.
Fixture writes happen only through applyDecision() after a genuine allow-once decision, confined to the admitted workspace by the helper itself.

Framing, message envelopes, permission options, cancel semantics and control evidence are taken from the sanitized Task 1 recordings (qoder-host-cli-1.1.61-protocol.jsonl/-events.json, opencode-host-cli-1.14.31-events.json).

Permission options are declared per tool kind because the recording offers proceed_always/"Allow for this session" for edit requests (protocol.jsonl lines 41/66/136) and proceed_always_and_save/"Always allow \"<program>\"" for execute requests (lines 84/165); the permission-request toolCall copy is built per kind (edit: title "Edit <basename>" and diff _meta.kind=add present; execute: identical to the tool_call update).

Fixture message texts for failures the recording does not contain (handshake rejection, unsupported model, provider error) reuse the recorded error envelope (-32000 / name+data shape); the texts themselves are fixture-defined.
The vendor available_commands_update list is deliberately not reproduced; the peers advertise a minimal fixture command list in the recorded envelope shape.

scenarios.title: Handshake, session creation, model acknowledgment, streaming and normal completion
scenarios.prompt: Reply with exactly the single word: pong
expected: no fixture write
no external model request
acknowledged model equals the requested model

scenarios.title: Completion that reports the observed model and the fixture usage counters
expected: exact recorded usage values pass through
the observed model comes from the core's report

scenarios.title: The core reports no usage counters and no observed model: unknown stays unknown

qoder.result: no usage member and no _meta.quota member

opencode.info: no tokens member and no modelID member

expected: unknown usage is null, never zero
the requested model is never reported as an observed model

scenarios.title: Two turns of one session: the core echoes the exact context it received
scenarios.prompt: Reply with the exact text you received

qoder.echo: the agent_message_chunk text is the exact text of the received prompt

opencode.echo: the assistant message text is the exact received text parts joined by a newline

expected: the second turn carries the exact prior user and assistant messages as context
no fixture write and no permission request

scenarios.title: Two permission requests with distinct ids: one granted write, one denied write
scenarios.prompt: Create the fixture file, then run the fixture command
expected: allow-once writes the exact bytes
denial creates no file
distinct request ids and toolCallIds

scenarios.title: Denial leaves the pre-existing bytes untouched
scenarios.prompt: Overwrite probe-deny.txt with the fixture text
expected: original bytes unchanged
no additional file created

scenarios.title: A pending permission expires and a late decision is refused
scenarios.prompt: Create probe-expiry.txt with the fixture text
expected: no write on expiry
late allow-once decision produces no write

scenarios.title: Cancel during a pending permission request
scenarios.prompt: Create probe-cancel-pending.txt with the fixture text

qoder.cancel: session/cancel notification while the request is unanswered

opencode.cancel: POST /session/:id/abort while the decision is pending

expected: no write
stopReason cancelled

scenarios.title: Process-level suspension: no outputs or writes advance while suspended, both resume afterwards
scenarios.prompt: Run this exact command with the Bash tool: node spawn-writer.mjs ticks.log. Keep streaming until cancelled

qoder.controlTechnique: process suspension of the owned tree (Task 1: nativePauseRpcUsed false)

opencode.streaming: assistant message parts appended every 1000 ms until aborted
opencode.controlTechnique: process suspension of the owned tree (Task 1: nativePauseRpcUsed false)

expected: zero new frames and zero byte growth while suspended
streaming and writer growth resume after resume

scenarios.title: Malformed, oversized and split protocol frames

emits: single line larger than 1 MiB that is still valid JSON
valid frame delivered as two partial writes

expected: the adapter must fail explicitly on malformed input
the peer must keep serving afterwards

scenarios.title: Core disconnects mid-prompt without a result

opencode.beforeDrop: response body truncated and the socket destroyed

expected: no prompt result is delivered
the adapter reports the disconnect as a failure

scenarios.title: Invalid authentication is rejected without a session
expected: no session is created
no provider fallback is attempted

scenarios.title: Unsupported model is refused without a core or model fallback
expected: explicit model rejection
no prompt execution

scenarios.title: Unsupported mode/control methods are refused with -32601, never invented
expected: no pause/resume RPC exists in the peer protocol

scenarios.title: A hung core leaves the request unanswered while staying alive
expected: the caller timeout must fire
the peer process stays alive

scenarios.title: Handshake rejection is explicit and terminal

error.message: Handshake rejected: fixture core does not accept protocolVersion 1

expected: no session is created
no retry with another core

scenarios.title: A controlled background child keeps writing after prompt completion
scenarios.prompt: Run this exact command with the Bash tool: node spawn-writer.mjs ticks.log. Then reply with the exact text DONE
expected: the writer keeps growing after the completion event
stopping the writer freezes the bytes
the writer is a real descendant process

scenarios.title: Non-cooperative shutdown ignores a cooperative cancel and a stdin close
scenarios.prompt: Run this exact command with the Bash tool: node spawn-writer.mjs ticks.log. Then reply with the exact text DONE

qoder.escalation: the harness must terminate the owned tree

opencode.escalation: the harness must terminate the owned tree

expected: the peer and the writer survive the cooperative cancel
terminating the tree kills both and freezes the bytes
